title: dead/ metrics gauge undercounts on read_dir entry Err
description: drain_once dead/ scan: Err branch at line 352 breaks the loop, setting the gauge to the partial count seen so far. Any entries after the failed entry are not counted. RELAY_DEAD_LETTER_DEPTH will silently report a number lower than the true dead-letter count, which defeats the purpose of the metric (alert on accumulation).
